mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_register_event_outbox (event_type, aggregate_id, payload, status, retry_count, next_retry_at) VALUES (#{eventType}, #{aggregateId}, #{payload}, #{status}, 0, datetime('now', 'localtime'))
mapper.select: SELECT id, event_type AS eventType, aggregate_id AS aggregateId, payload, status, retry_count AS retryCount, next_retry_at AS nextRetryAt, last_error AS lastError FROM tb_register_event_outbox WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT id, event_type AS eventType, aggregate_id AS aggregateId, payload, status, retry_count AS retryCount, next_retry_at AS nextRetryAt, last_error AS lastError FROM tb_register_event_outbox WHERE status IN (0, 2) AND retry_count < #{maxRetry} AND next_retry_at <= datetime('now', 'localtime') ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_register_event_outbox SET status = 2, retry_count = retry_count + 1, next_retry_at = datetime('now', 'localtime', '+' || ((retry_count + 1) * 10) || ' seconds'), last_error = #{lastError}, updated_at = datetime('now', 'localtime') WHERE id = #{id}
